scenes.question: Which of two witnesses should we believe?

beats.say: Imagine two friends guessing the temperature outside. One has a cheap thermometer that wobbles a lot. The other has a precise one. You would not ignore either of them, but you would trust the precise one more, and the wobbly one only a little. And if the precise friend is away one day, you still have a sensible guess.

Since 2012, MODIS and VIIRS both report on the same farms. Formula thirty-eight, Kalman fusion with a local-level model, blends them month by month, trusting each in proportion to its precision. It is an experimental layer, and it is always labelled as a model estimate.

parts.say: First, the hidden truth. x t is the underlying fire activity in month t. It is last month's level, plus a small random step, w t.
That step is drawn from a normal curve with spread Q. A small Q means the true level changes slowly.
Then the measurements. Each sensor s reports z, which is the true level plus its own error, v.

Each sensor's error has its own spread, R s. A precise sensor has a small R, and the filter listens to it more. Missing months are simply skipped, and the estimate carries on smoothly through the gap.

scenes.title: How much each sensor is trusted

steps.label: Harmonised MODIS error
steps.say: The measurement noise comes from validation. Harmonised MODIS has a standard deviation of 0.40, from the Bland-Altman test, formula twenty-three.

steps.label: VIIRS error
steps.say: VIIRS is much more precise, with 0.12. The step size Q is 0.02.

steps.label: Steady gain on MODIS
steps.say: Before 2012, the gain on harmonised MODIS settles at about 0.23. Each new MODIS month moves the estimate by about a fifth of its surprise. After 2012, VIIRS dominates because it is much more precise, while MODIS still pulls slightly.

beats.say: Here are the deseasonalised log monthly cell-days from harmonised MODIS and from VIIRS S-NPP, as two clouds of points.

The line is the fused level, with its ninety-five percent band. Before 2012, the line is steered by harmonised MODIS alone, a fifth of each surprise at a time. After 2012 the line follows VIIRS closely, while MODIS still pulls slightly.

beats.label: The local-level model
beats.say: On the FIREWORK website, the formula page for formula thirty-eight shows the model. Fusion is an optional layer, showing how a single best estimate could combine all instruments.

beats.label: Key numbers · status experimental
beats.say: The key numbers include its status: experimental. Its result is a model estimate, so it is labelled as such and never shown as an observation.

points: Hidden level drifts slowly; each sensor sees it with its own noise
Experimental: a model estimate, never an observation

beats.say: So, to remember: the Kalman filter blends two witnesses, giving more weight to the precise one, and carries the level smoothly through gaps. It is a model, and FIREWORK always says so.
